name: local-news
description: Weekly Clark County, NV local news across four beats: Government/Development, School Board, Real Estate Market, and Local News and Events, plus national real estate headlines reframed against Las Vegas numbers. Sub-agents rank 27+ stories by viral potential and produce green-screen transcripts, blogs, bonus SEO blogs, Reddit posts, captions, YouTube descriptions, a posting schedule, and a spreadsheet.
